note: The Relics Table (d66) and its relics (Playtest v1.11, pp. 163–170), named and numbered as their entries print them: the table lists Talisman of Protection at 46 and no 21–22. A relic counts in the warband rating at its price, as step seven has it (p. 156). `who`: leaders – a Leader or Champion; ranged – a fighter with a ranged weapon on its lists; casters – a Wizard or Priest; a wargear id – a fighter that may take that piece.

wargear.name: Saint Trickster's Charm
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

At the end of this fighter's activation, if they do not hold treasure and are engaged in melee with an enemy fighter that does, you can roll a dice. On a 4+, that enemy fighter is no longer holding that treasure, this fighter is holding it instead.

wargear.name: Enchanted Coin Purse
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence, if this fighter took part in the battle, their warband earns an additional 2d6 silver.

wargear.name: Von Zikmund Pocketwatch
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

You can re-roll reinforcement rolls made for this fighter.

wargear.name: Ring of Roses
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

This fighter cannot be Poisoned. In addition, in step 7 of each aftermath sequence, you can remove 1 level of Black Rot from this fighter.

wargear.name: Pilgrim's Eye
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

This item grants 1 exploration re-roll (tens dice only) if this fighter is included in the scouting party.

If the re-rolled dice is a 1, the item shatters.

wargear.name: Saint Restoria's Charm
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Hold Charm [Bonus Action]:** Heal this fighter d6 life.

wargear.name: Dwarven Whetstone
wargear.text:
*Stash Item, Relic*

At the start of each battle, pick a melee weapon a friendly fighter is armed with and roll a dice. On a 1, the whetstone has worn down, remove the Dwarven Whetstone from your stash. On a 2+, increase the Rend value of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

wargear.name: Blackrose Candle
wargear.text:
*Stash Item, Relic*

You can use this item in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Pick a friendly fighter that has an injury and roll a dice. On a 2+ they no longer have that injury.

wargear.name: Peculiar Flask
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

The first time this fighter activates each battle, roll a dice to determine which Wondrous Tonic the flask holds: 1 Tonic of Speed, 2 Tonic of Strength, 3 Tonic of Steady Aim, 4 Tonic of Fortitude, 5 Tonic of Mind, 6 Tonic of Levitation.

wargear.name: Deepwood Boots
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

Add 1" to this fighter's Move value.

wargear.name: Saint Fortuna's Charm
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

Each time this fighter makes a ranged attack or a melee attack, you can re-roll 1 attack dice.

wargear.name: Banner of Lost Souls
wargear.text:
*Held Item, Relic*

**[Action]** Once per battle, while the bearer is not engaged in melee, they can use this held item as an action. If they do so, roll a dice. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2+, pick a friendly fighter that is taken down. Set up that friendly fighter within 1" of this fighter, not engaged in melee. That fighter is healed d3 life.

wargear.name: Golden Newt
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

Only *Wizards* and *Priests* can be equipped with this item.

Once per battle, when this fighter makes an Arcane Action to Cast a Spell, they can use the Golden Newt. If they do so, they are considered to have drawn power.

wargear.name: Shield of Thorns
wargear.text:
*Held Item, Relic*

Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

In addition, each time this fighter makes an armour roll of a natural 6 against a melee attack, the attacking fighters suffers 1 damage.

wargear.name: Iron Ward
wargear.text:
*Item, Relic*

Add 1 to the fighter's Armour value (to a maximum of 2+).

wargear.name: Heirloom Duelling Pistol
wargear.text:
*Ranged Weapon, Relic*

Any fighter that can be equipped with a blackpowder pistol can be equipped with a Heirloom Duelling Pistol.

wargear.name: Poison Quiver & Bow
wargear.text:
*Ranged Weapon, Relic*

Any fighter that can be equipped with a ranged weapon can be equipped with a Poison Quiver & Bow.

wargear.name: Repeater Crossbow
wargear.text:
*Ranged Weapon, Relic*

Any fighter that can be equipped with a ranged weapon can be equipped with a Repeater Crossbow.

wargear.name: Poison Needle
wargear.text:
*Melee Weapon, Relic*

Any Leader or Champion can be equipped with a Poison Needle.

wargear.text:
*Melee Weapon, Relic*

Any Leader or Champion can be equipped with a Dwarven Axe.

wargear.name: Noble's Rapier

*Melee Weapon, Relic*

wargear.name: Headsman's Axe
wargear.text:
*Melee Weapon, Relic*

wargear.name: Halberd of the City
wargear.text:
*Melee Weapon, Relic*

Any Leader or Champion can be equipped with a Halberd of the City.

legendaryBlade.text:
*Melee Weapon, Relic*

Any Leader or Champion can be equipped with a Legendary Blade. Its two properties were rolled when it was found.
